text:
I understand the urgency! Unfortunately, we can't redirect shipped orders. Once an order has shipped, the shipping address is locked and can't be changed—and couriers don't accept redirection requests from Leafy on our behalf.

Your best option now is to contact the courier directly using the tracking number in your shipping email; they may be able to help with a redirect, though it depends on their policies and how far your package has travelled.

What's your order number? I can look into whether there are any other options, but I want to be upfront that the courier contact is really your main avenue here.
